exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤2.5 x ULN; alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤2.5 x ULN (AST, ALT ≤5 x ULN if liver metastases present)
exclusions.threshold: AST, ALT ≤2.5 x ULN (≤5 x ULN if liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Active or progressing central nervous system (CNS) metastases or any evidence of leptomeningeal disease.
